# Frozen domain-name compatibility fixture

`pre-domain-names-v9.gob` was generated by core `bc15a8b43224f3af007faed9d9a4f3255f6efd8d`
using synthetic DTOs, before renaming `flow.Range` and `flow.Box`. It contains an
address, a route policy match, StaticNAT and DynamicNAT. The retained raw text is
deliberately not parseable. The fixture asserts decoding and semantic digest
stability across Go API renames, not compatibility with obsolete semantic formats.
Do not regenerate it using newer types.
